name: Flip logo grid
purpose: Shows breadth of customers compactly by cycling sixteen logos through four animated cells.
description: Four logo cells in a row (2x2 at <=767) between side hairlines, each with legacy-theme borders. Every cell masks a 3rem-high window onto a vertical track of four logos, so 16 logos are shown four at a time. Once the section scrolls into view each track steps upward through its logos on a staggered, looping GSAP timeline. Geometry is identical on every route; only the legacy colour theme changes (yellow on /content/topics, /content/sector-suites and /content/service, pink on /lms/impact, green on /content/custom-content).

placeholderLabel.note: Label drawn inside the neutral placeholder slot (Placeholder.jsx label prop).

assetRef.note: ONLY for roles whose generationPolicy is may-generate-new (ASSET_REF_FORBIDDEN_FOR_PROTECTED_ROLE). Must point at a NEWLY generated file under generated/ -- never /assets/, public/assets/ or a URL. The 56 files in the source project's public/assets/ are the user's local reference copies of the original site's imagery and are never valid here.

logos.note: Four per cell, in cell order.

constraints.maxPerPageDerivation: derived: the most times this (section, variant) occurs on any real template (templates/templates.json)

motion.reducedMotionNote: The schema REQUIRES this fallback on every generated node. Neither the original site nor the clone implements prefers-reduced-motion; this is a generation-time requirement, not a description of the source.
motion.note: Starts once the section enters the viewport (IntersectionObserver, threshold 0). Each column's track waits (2s, or 1.5s first step on column 3) then moves up to ~-28/-54/-80% in 850ms power3.out, three times, snaps back to 0 and repeats forever; columns start offset by 0 / 250 / 300 / 500ms.

evidenceNotes: Default logos are the labels 'Logo 1' ... 'Logo 16'; no page overrides them.
The track holds exactly four logos per cell; with fewer than 16 logos some cells would step into blank space, so slots is fixed at 16.
